title: galaxy-studio-spec
universal_lens: The Galaxy Studio formalizes a multi-output generative manifold where a single intelligence node maps to a vector of distinct creator assets. This structural unification relies on a strict compliance kernel, ensuring that every generated asset maintains an isomorphic mapping back to the foundational empirical evidence.
gsi_mapping: Within GSI, the compliance scanner acts as a conformal inference layer. It bounds the epistemic uncertainty of LLM-generated text by enforcing citation constraints. Unsupported claims are rejected if they exceed the allowable error rate defined by the underlying `PickSignalSnapshot` confidence intervals.
gse_mapping: For GSE, the Studio represents a constrained state-transition system. The input game node transitions into multiple discrete output states (fan explainer, fantasy angle). Each transition is governed by template-specific Hamiltonian rules, strictly vetoing trajectories that violate domain-specific voice or compliance boundaries.

primitives.name: Intelligence-to-Asset Manifold Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## TL;DR Galaxy Studio turns one unit of intelligence (one game or one slate) into multiple monetizable assets in a single workflow.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Unit of intelligence: dimensionless graph node representing a singular sporting event; Monetizable asset: discrete string artifact with semantic payload.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the underlying Intelligence Graph contains sufficient high-dimensional features to support diverse downstream projections without hallucination.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when the source intelligence node lacks sufficient signal density, causing the generator to produce collinear or degenerate assets across different templates.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a many-to-one projection operator in GSE, collapsing a high-dimensional situational state into multiple lower-dimensional communicative vectors while preserving core informational entropy.
layer2.telemetry: Asset diversity index and cross-template claim consistency metrics.

primitives.name: Compliance & Citation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Every asset: - Carries citations linked to the underlying `PickSignalSnapshot` or `GameSignal` rows.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Citation: pointer/reference type linking natural language tokens to structured database rows; PickSignalSnapshot: time-series data structure.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a bijective mapping exists between any valid statistical assertion in the generated text and a retrievable row in the local evidence graph.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur during complex causal reasoning where the LLM synthesizes novel insights not explicitly stored in the `GameSignal` rows, triggering false-positive compliance failures.

layer2.mapping: Functions as a hard constraint satisfaction problem in GSI, acting as a post-hoc filter that projects unconstrained LLM outputs onto the subspace of empirically verified truths.
layer2.telemetry: Citation coverage ratio and compliance scan pass/fail rates per template.

primitives.name: Voice & Tone Boundary Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Fantasy angle** — DFS / season-long lens on the same game.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: VoiceTone: categorical variable defining permissible lexical space; DFS/season-long: domain-specific contextual framing.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes distinct audience segments require mutually exclusive lexical spaces (e.g., banning betting terminology in fan explainers) to maintain brand safety.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the banned vocabulary list is too sparse, allowing semantically equivalent but lexically distinct prohibited concepts to leak through the compliance scanner.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's situational reasoning filters, dynamically altering the action space available to the generative agent based on the target audience's cognitive framework.
layer2.telemetry: Lexical overlap scores between generated assets and the banned vocabulary corpus.

reasoning_traces.think:
The Galaxy Studio specification defines a rigorous mathematical pipeline for converting raw sports intelligence into structured, compliant media assets. At its core, the system operates as a constrained optimization engine. The input is a highly dimensional `GameIntelligenceNode`, which encapsulates all known signals regarding a specific sporting event. The objective function seeks to maximize the utility of this node by projecting it onto multiple orthogonal subspaces—namely, the fan explainer, fantasy angle, and betting education domains. However, unlike standard generative models that optimize purely for perplexity or fluency, the Studio introduces a hard constraint layer: the Compliance Scanner. This scanner functions as a topological filter, rejecting any generated trajectory that violates the predefined voice-tone boundaries or fails to establish a bijective mapping between textual assertions and underlying `PickSignalSnapshot` rows. The dualities emerge in how the same underlying truth (e.g., a team's home performance) is mathematically transformed into vastly different communicative vectors depending on the target audience. Failure modes are primarily localized at the boundary conditions of the citation kernel. When the LLM attempts to perform higher-order synthesis that exceeds the explicit granularity of the source data, the citation extractor fails, leading to a compliance veto. Thus, the system's robustness is entirely dependent on the density and resolution of the upstream Intelligence Graph.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architecture inherits directly from the lineage of automated technical reporting and regulatory-compliant financial disclosures. Historically, systems attempting to auto-generate market commentary faced severe backlash due to hallucinated statistics. The Studio adapts the 'show your work' paradigm from symbolic AI, forcing neural networks to ground their probabilistic outputs in deterministic database lookups, effectively bridging the gap between connectionist flexibility and logicist rigor.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system implicitly models two distinct decision actors: the Creator and the End-User. The Creator is modeled as an efficiency-seeking agent who desires maximum output diversity with minimum manual effort, hence the batch generation feature. The End-User, however, is segmented into distinct cognitive profiles (casual fan vs. DFS optimizer). The Studio's voice-tone rules act as a theory-of-mind proxy, anticipating the user's prior knowledge and risk tolerance, deliberately suppressing high-variance betting terminology when addressing the casual demographic to prevent cognitive dissonance.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced via the template-specific compliance rules. A critical veto condition exists to prevent leakage between the 'Fan explainer' and 'Betting education' layers. If the fan explainer inadvertently contains semantic markers associated with gambling (e.g., 'edge', 'line'), the Layer 1 platform-wide ban triggers an immediate hard fail. This cross-layer veto ensures that the distinct epistemic frames of reference remain strictly isolated, preventing the contamination of sponsor-safe content with regulated financial terminology.
